subject: Significance of R-Square in path model

messages.author: 04b0cab4c0830c1f
messages.subject: Significance of R-Square in path model
parts:
Hello,

I calculated a path model in R using lavaan. I would like to know the p-value of the R-square value (I have the R-square value and I want to know how significant it is). How do I get that value?

Thank you very much in advance for your help!

Best regards,
Cecilia

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: Significance of R-Square in path model
parts:
Here's one way: 

The significance of R-square is the joint significance of all of the parameters that predict a variable.

You can test the significance by fixing all of those parameters to be equal to zero. Here's a simple example that shows you get the same p-value in lavaan, and by using the lm() function:

library(lavaan)
set.seed(1234)
d <- data.frame(x1 = runif(1000), x2 = runif(1000))
d$y <- 0.05 * d$x1 + 0.05 * d$x2 + runif(1000)

summary(lm(y ~ x1 + x2, data = d))

mod1 <- "y ~ b1 * x1 + b2 * x2
         x1 ~~ x2
        "        
fit1 <- sem(mod1, d)
summary(fit1)

mod0 <- "y ~ 0 * x1 + 0 * x2"        
fit0 <- sem(mod0, d)
summary(fit0)

(If you're model is more complex, you might need to use anova() or you can do a Wald test with lavTestWald()).

Jeremy
